prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: original furniture sprite atlas for an interactive cozy children's room decorator. Generate a landscape 1536x1024 PNG with genuinely TRANSPARENT background. STRICT 3 columns x 2 rows equally sized cells, each cell 512x512, NO lines or borders. SIX completely isolated individual objects, one per cell, no scene or room or floor tile. Each object centered in its cell, fully visible with generous 40px empty margins. Keep shadows small, soft and self-contained. Consistent isometric view, looking down at 30 degrees, front-facing edges slope down-right and down-left; warm cream, honey oak, muted sage and coral, clean rounded shapes, delicate outlined hand-painted game art, readable at small size. Original designs, no references to existing games.
Cell row1 col1: cozy single wooden bed with cream pillow and sage green quilt, long axis toward bottom left. Row1 col2: low honey-oak writing desk, a single small closed coral book, long front edge toward bottom right. Row1 col3: single cozy sage padded wooden chair with visible seat facing bottom left.
Row2 col1: small honey-oak bookcase, four shelves with pastel books, front facing bottom left. Row2 col2: leafy round green houseplant in coral terracotta pot. Row2 col3: flat oval cream woven rug with sage concentric border, lying on an isometric plane.
No text, no words, no labels, no watermark, no people. NOT pixel art, not photorealistic, no room background. This must be a functional transparent sprite atlas with exactly six isolated objects kept within their separate grid cells.
avatar: Original procedural Canvas geometry: rabbit/cat/bear; layered clothing, colors, headwear; no external avatar sprites.
scope: Isolated localStorage prototype; no production APIs.
